page.title: Roles
page.description: This page displays role information, where you can view role details, create new roles, edit existing ones, or remove roles from the system.

create.title: New Role
create.description: Use this form to define a new role within the system. A role determines the access level and permissions granted to users assigned to it.

update.title: Update Role
update.description: Use this form to update role within the system. A role determines the access level and permissions granted to users assigned to it.

delete.title: Delete Role
delete.description: This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All associations with this role will also be removed.

duplicate.title: Duplicate Role
duplicate.description: This action will duplicate the role, including all its associations. You can undo this action later if needed.

create.title: Create Role
create.description: Create a new role with the specified permissions.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.description: Select the permissions for this role.

update.title: Update Role
update.description: Update a new role with the specified permissions.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.description: Select the permissions for this role.
